description: Asrai's live market radar: what is happening in crypto right now — sudden moves (15 min), liquidations summed across Binance, Bybit and OKX, volume spikes, futures open interest and funding extremes (crowded longs/shorts), Coinbase premium (US buying/selling), new 30-day/90-day/1-year highs and lows, new listings, key news and Asrai signals. Newest first, each with size (huge/big/all). Use for 'what's moving now', 'any liquidations', 'is the market busy', or to check a coin's last hours before a trade.

coins.description: Only these coins, comma-separated tickers, e.g. 'SOL,ETH' (default all)

level.description: Smallest event size to include (default big)

name: market_radar
title: Live market radar
